content.value_statement: Docker projects can become slow, large, and hard to secure. This skill guides Dockerfile, Compose, secrets, and validation improvements.
actual_capabilities: Reviews Dockerfiles for layer ordering, base image choice, user permissions, and health checks.
Suggests multi-stage build patterns for smaller production images.
Designs Docker Compose service dependencies, networks, volumes, secrets, and resource limits.
Provides validation steps for Docker builds, image history, runtime checks, and Compose configuration.
Recommends Docker secrets and BuildKit secret mounts instead of hardcoded values.
Offers checklists for security, performance, workflow, networking, and deployment readiness.
limitations: It does not replace testing in the target container environment.
It is not focused on Kubernetes, cloud container services, or CI systems.
Validation commands require Docker installed and user approval to run.
Examples may need updates for each language, framework, and production policy.

use_cases.title: Harden a production Dockerfile
use_cases.description: Review image users, secret handling, package footprint, health checks, and runtime defaults before release.

use_cases.title: Reduce image size before deployment
use_cases.description: Convert a large build into a smaller multi-stage image with cleaner dependency and artifact handling.

use_cases.title: Review Compose service design
use_cases.description: Check service dependencies, networks, volumes, resource limits, and secret references for a multi-service app.

prompt_templates.title: Review my Dockerfile
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one container build.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Dockerfile for caching, security, image size, and health checks. Explain the highest priority changes first.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Compose stack
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of local or staging services.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Docker Compose setup for service startup order, networks, volumes, secrets, resource limits, and development workflow issues.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a production container build
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced migration from development image to production image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a production-ready Docker approach for this project. Include build stages, runtime user, secret handling, validation steps, and rollback risks.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a container release
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a release audit for these Docker files and logs. Prioritize security, reproducibility, runtime stability, and operational validation.

output_examples.input: Review a Node container that runs as root and copies the full source before installing dependencies.
output: Main issues: root runtime, weak layer caching, oversized build context, and missing health check.
Recommended changes: install dependencies before copying source, create a non-root runtime user, and add a focused ignore file.
Validation: rebuild the image, compare image size, inspect runtime processes, and confirm the health endpoint behavior.

output_examples.input: Check a Compose file with an app service, database service, shared network, and plain password variables.
output: Main issues: database readiness is not enforced, backend traffic is not isolated, and secrets use plain environment variables.
Recommended changes: add database health checks, split frontend and backend networks, and move credentials to Docker secrets.
Validation: confirm service startup order, check network reachability, and verify secret references in the running stack.

output_examples.input: Find ways to make a large production image smaller and easier to scan.
output: Main issues: build tools are present in the final image and package caches remain after installation.
Recommended changes: separate build and runtime stages, copy only required artifacts, and use a minimal runtime base.
Validation: compare image history, scan the final image, and run the application smoke tests.

best_practices: Share Dockerfile, Compose, ignore file, and relevant build logs for a complete review.
Confirm before running build, run, scan, or cleanup commands against a real project.
Apply changes in small steps and test each image before deployment.
anti_patterns: Using it for deep Kubernetes, cloud service, or CI pipeline work outside Docker scope.
Running suggested commands against production systems without review and approval.
Copying examples without adapting users, secrets, ports, networks, and runtime policy.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews Dockerfiles, Docker Compose patterns, container security, image size, health checks, and production readiness.

faq.question: Can it write a Dockerfile from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the application stack, build steps, runtime command, ports, and deployment target.

faq.question: Does it handle Kubernetes deployments?
faq.answer: Only at a handoff level. It focuses on Docker and Compose, not Kubernetes orchestration details.

faq.question: Will it run Docker commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. Commands should be reviewed and approved before they run in the workspace.

faq.question: Can it help with container secrets?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends Docker secrets, BuildKit secret mounts, and avoiding hardcoded credentials.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best results?
faq.answer: Provide Docker files, Compose files, ignore files, build logs, runtime errors, and deployment goals.
